scope: Q2 daytime screening plus additional fire screening and ground borehole maintenance; not measured conservation outcomes or full-park staffing
staff_reference_rule: 295 department staff times 60 percent monthly protection-task availability; not simultaneous headcount
fleet_rule: inherit Q2 30-aircraft inventory and 1200 aggregate flight hours/month; aircraft inventory is not simultaneous crew demand

evidence_status.dry_window: research-based seasonal classification; not observed drought in 2026
evidence_status.fire_windows: official 2016 Etosha fire strategy; not incident forecasts
evidence_status.water_points: coordinates and BH/A/C labels manually transcribed from original Table1; May2013 survey
evidence_status.frequencies_and_visit_durations: team planning assumptions expressed as 30-day maximum service gaps; no actual operational logs available
evidence_status.abnormal_drought: conditional workload stress scenario applied to dry months; no SPI or precipitation prediction
evidence_status.route_sharing: no shared-trip credit; separate sorties avoid double-counting completed work but can overestimate travel
